transcripts.reference: AGENT GUIDELINES: If waiting < 7 days, ask the customer to wait. If waiting >= 7 days, reship at no cost.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My package hasn't arrived, it's been 3 days since it shipped.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll ship a replacement right now — sorry about that.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I want to cancel my subscription and switch to your competitor.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: OK, cancellations are handled by another team, not us.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I need to update my card.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure, please type the full 16-digit card number and CVV here in chat.
